observed_problem: 94.04% training trajectories within0.1 of log1025; frozen nested-contrast probe reduces near-zero trajectory action-logit sensitivities from37.5% to14.1% with L4096.
uncertainty: This supports sensitivity testing, not proof of a causal EIG plateau; original run has no intermediate held-out checkpoints.
hypothesis: More contrastive likelihood samples provide useful EIG gradients for residual correction learning while preserving sparse four-expert architecture.
fixed: Original pretrained base, frozen base, residual initialization, four64/64tanh experts, sumencoder, DSelect1, gamma30/95, componentclip5, penalties, Adam, one million additional primary episodes, evaluation2000/L1million.
proposed_control: Continued DAD-MLP from the original base for one million additional episodes at L4096, fresh Adam; compare also the existing L1024 additional-training control.
fairness: Raising L benefits optimization generically and costs four times as many contrast likelihoods. Gains alone cannot be attributed to MoE; compare against matched single-policy control.
training_randomness: Same seed convention; changing contrast count changes RNG consumption and hence realized training noise. Prior/likelihood distributions and held-out pairing stay fixed.
selection: ResMoE is numerically highest initial development EIG; its difference from SwitchResMoE is not asserted statistically meaningful.
status: Bounded cost preflight queued; no full intervention launched until measured cost is reviewed.
